[Act: motor-vehicles
 Chapter: Registration of Motor Vehicles
 Section: 40::Registration, where to be made.
]


Subject to the provisions of section 42, section 43 and section 60, every owner of a motor vehicle shall cause the vehicle to be registered by 1[any registering authority in the State] in 2[which] he has the residence or place of business where the vehicle is normally kept.
